data.title: Solana and XRP spot ETFs see inflows as Bitcoin and Ethereum face combined $520M in outflows
data.description: Bitcoin and Ethereum spot ETFs hemorrhaged a combined $520 million on September 16, while Solana and XRP quietly absorbed fresh capital.Bitcoin ETFs shed $295.98 million in net outflows, with Ethereum not far behind at $224.11 million.
